name: konvizi-mcp

tools.name: convert_image
tools.description: Convert images between formats (input: JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, GIF, TIFF, SVG, HEIC/HEIF; output: jpg, png, webp, avif, gif, tiff, ico). Also compresses (lower quality) and resizes (width/height, aspect ratio kept). One output file per input image.

files.description: Absolute paths of the images, in order.

format.description: Output format. Default: same as the input (HEIC → JPG, SVG → PNG).

quality.description: Quality 1–100 for JPG/WebP/AVIF (lower = smaller file). For PNG, any value below 100 reduces the palette.

output_dir.description: Folder for the results. Default: the folder of the (first) input file.

annotations.title: Convertir, compresser ou redimensionner des images

tools.name: images_to_pdf
tools.description: Put one or more images (JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, GIF, TIFF, SVG, HEIC) into a single PDF, one image per A4 page, in the given order.

files.description: Absolute paths of the images, in order.

output.description: Absolute path of the result file. Default: next to the input, with a name that never overwrites an existing file.

tools.name: pdf_to_images
tools.description: Render PDF pages as images (one PNG or JPG file per page).

file.description: Absolute path of the input file (a path starting with ~ is also accepted).

pages.description: Pages, numbered from 1, e.g. "1-3, 5, 8-" ("8-" means 8 to the end). Default: all pages.

output_dir.description: Folder for the results. Default: the folder of the (first) input file.

tools.name: merge_pdfs
tools.description: Merge several PDF files into one, in the given order.

files.description: Absolute paths of the PDF files, in order.

output.description: Absolute path of the result file. Default: next to the input, with a name that never overwrites an existing file.

tools.name: split_pdf
tools.description: Split a PDF into several PDFs: one per page by default, or one per range given in "ranges" (e.g. ["1-3", "4-10"]).

file.description: Absolute path of the input file (a path starting with ~ is also accepted).

ranges.description: Page ranges, one output PDF per entry, e.g. ["1-3", "4-", "7"]. Default: one PDF per page.

output_dir.description: Folder for the results. Default: the folder of the (first) input file.

tools.name: extract_pdf_pages
tools.description: Create a new PDF containing only the chosen pages, in the order given (can also reorder pages, e.g. "3, 1, 2").

file.description: Absolute path of the input file (a path starting with ~ is also accepted).

pages.description: Pages to keep, numbered from 1, e.g. "1-3, 5, 8-".

output.description: Absolute path of the result file. Default: next to the input, with a name that never overwrites an existing file.

tools.name: delete_pdf_pages
tools.description: Create a copy of a PDF without the chosen pages. The original file is kept.

file.description: Absolute path of the input file (a path starting with ~ is also accepted).

pages.description: Pages to remove, numbered from 1, e.g. "2, 5-7".

output.description: Absolute path of the result file. Default: next to the input, with a name that never overwrites an existing file.

tools.name: rotate_pdf
tools.description: Rotate pages of a PDF clockwise by 90, 180 or 270 degrees. Writes a new file; the original is kept.

file.description: Absolute path of the input file (a path starting with ~ is also accepted).

pages.description: Pages, numbered from 1, e.g. "1-3, 5, 8-" ("8-" means 8 to the end). Default: all pages.

output.description: Absolute path of the result file. Default: next to the input, with a name that never overwrites an existing file.

tools.name: pdf_to_text
tools.description: Extract the text of a PDF into a .txt file (UTF-8). The text is also returned (up to 20,000 characters). Scanned PDFs without a text layer are not supported.

file.description: Absolute path of the input file (a path starting with ~ is also accepted).

output.description: Absolute path of the result file. Default: next to the input, with a name that never overwrites an existing file.

tools.name: word_to_text
tools.description: Extract the text of a Word document (.docx) into a .txt file, keeping lists and tables (cells separated by tabs). The text is also returned (up to 20,000 characters). Old .doc files are not supported.

file.description: Absolute path of the input file (a path starting with ~ is also accepted).

output.description: Absolute path of the result file. Default: next to the input, with a name that never overwrites an existing file.

tools.name: text_to_pdf
tools.description: Create a PDF (A4, Noto Sans 11pt, automatic line wrapping; Latin, Greek, Cyrillic and Devanagari scripts) from a .txt file or from text. A form feed character starts a new page.

file.description: Absolute path of a .txt file (UTF-8, UTF-16 or Windows-1252).

text.description: The text itself, instead of a file. Then "output" is required.

output.description: Absolute path of the result file. Default: next to the input, with a name that never overwrites an existing file.

tools.name: text_to_word
tools.description: Create a Word document (.docx) from a .txt file or from text: one paragraph per line, tabs kept, form feed = page break.

file.description: Absolute path of a .txt file (UTF-8, UTF-16 or Windows-1252).

text.description: The text itself, instead of a file. Then "output" is required.

output.description: Absolute path of the result file. Default: next to the input, with a name that never overwrites an existing file.

tools.name: list_conversions
tools.description: List what this Konvizi server can do, and what is only available on the konvizi.com website.

instructions: Konvizi converts files on the user's own computer: PDF tools (merge, split, extract, delete, rotate pages, PDF to images, images to PDF, PDF to text), image conversion/compression/resizing (JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, GIF, TIFF, ICO; reads HEIC and SVG too), and Word/text conversions (DOCX to TXT, TXT to DOCX, TXT to PDF). All paths must be absolute (or start with ~). Results are written next to the original file unless output_dir/output is given, and existing files are never overwritten. Nothing is uploaded anywhere. For tools not offered here (OCR, audio, Excel, PDF passwords, signing), point the user to https://konvizi.com.
